home_headline:
Open the Word.
Live the Journey.
home_intro: Free devotionals, Bible studies, and practical ministry resources to help people know God's Word and follow Jesus with purpose.
home_note: Freely shared. Rooted in Scripture. Made for real life.
home_mission_heading:
Helping people find their way
through God's Word.
home_mission_intro: Whether you're opening the Bible on your own, leading a small group, or preparing to teach, we believe faithful biblical resources should be accessible to everyone.
home_devotional_intro: A 66-week journey through all 66 books of Scripture. Read the PDF for free, or choose a physical copy through Amazon when available.
home_pastors_heading: Built to be shared, not kept on a shelf.
home_pastors_intro: Pastors and ministry leaders: explore teaching material you can adapt for your church, small group, or student ministry.
home_journal_heading: A little more time in the Word.
home_journal_intro: Read occasional reflections on Scripture, discipleship, and the everyday Christian life.
devotionals_intro: Discover Scripture one book at a time. Our downloadable devotionals are designed to help you open the Bible and explore it for yourself.
devotionals_series_intro: Download a free PDF, or purchase a paperback through Amazon.
pastors_intro: Teaching material for pastors, student leaders, small-group facilitators, and families. Practical, biblical, and freely accessible.
pastors_library_intro: Search and filter the example resources below. Download links will be connected to the final approved files.
journal_intro: Occasional reflections to encourage you to read the Bible, trust God's Word, and live what you learn.
shop_intro: Simple apparel designed to spark conversations about faith and Scripture. Merchandise sales can help sustain the ministry.
about_intro: An independent Christian discipleship ministry with one simple conviction: God's Word is worth opening, understanding, and sharing.
about_mission_heading:
Discover the Word.
Deepen your faith.
Live the journey.
about_mission_intro: Lost Then Found exists to help people engage Scripture personally and to equip those who teach it. We believe accessible resources can help believers move from simply hearing about the Bible to reading it for themselves.
about_mission_extra: That's why we want to offer devotionals and original teaching materials free of charge.
founder_bio: With approximately two decades of student and family ministry experience, Travis created Lost Then Found to encourage biblical literacy and equip pastors, families, and everyday Christians with practical resources.
support_intro: Our vision is to make biblical discipleship resources available without putting a price between people and God's Word.
support_why_intro: Support can help cover resource creation, editing, design, hosting, and the distribution of free devotionals and ministry materials.
footer_intro: Free devotionals and biblical resources to help people open God's Word and live the journey.
